item.title: MonoPhone 0.1.41
item.description:
What's new in MonoPhone for Mac

  • The camera button in a video call responds at once and shows when the video is starting. You see "Turning camera on…" while the other person's picture is on its way, and "Video paused, reconnecting…" instead of a frozen picture; it recovers by itself.
  • Add participant has a Contacts tab: pick people from the company phonebook and your own contacts next to your colleagues.
  • Push-to-talk channels show who is online at once.
  • Video and screen sharing are offered on calls with colleagues; on calls to phone numbers the buttons are dimmed with a short explanation.

item.title: MonoPhone 0.1.40
item.description:
What's new in MonoPhone for Mac

  • MonoPhone 1.1: messaging on a par with the best chat apps, steadier group video rooms with screen sharing, and sign-in on as many devices as you like.
  • Video rooms name every colleague on the tiles, keep the people you added when you leave, and stay live while a new person's phone rings; if they cannot be reached, MonoPhone says why.
  • Turn any call into a video conference, add participants by name or number, and see live captions in video calls.
  • Copilot from a new icon when your company's AI is on.
  • "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen, and a clear explanation when you have too many devices signed in.

item.title: MonoPhone 0.1.39
item.description:
What's new in MonoPhone for Mac

  • Chat works again with company phone systems that have not been updated yet: sending a message no longer fails there.
  • Messages: typing and online / last seen, photo albums, shared contacts, a video call button in one-to-one chats, drafts that keep the reply and mentions, every emoji for reactions, search in message text, and clearer sent and read ticks.
  • End-to-end encrypted chats keep their keys after a restart and can be verified by QR code.
  • Video rooms and screen sharing are steadier, and a shared screen gets the large tile.
  • "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen, and a clear explanation when you have too many devices signed in.

item.title: MonoPhone 0.1.38
item.description:
What's new in MonoPhone for Mac

  • The app can now update itself: Check for Updates… in the app menu and in Settings, with daily background checks on by default (an administrator can turn them off). If an update can't install automatically, MonoPhone offers to open our website so you can download it directly.
